skill.name: seo-experiment-ledger
skill.description: Maintain a controlled SEO experiment for one exact query and target page using comparable observations and scheduled reviews.
skill.summary: Track focused SEO page experiments from baseline through review.
skill.author: cucuwang

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code backticks, not Ruby or shell command-substitution syntax. The documented geoptimize commands are purpose-aligned, but the workflow also directs repository commits and a production deployment without requiring explicit approval.

remediation.issue: The workflow directs the agent to commit changes and deploy a page without an explicit approval checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before each commit and production deployment, and show the exact pending changes before approval.

content.value_statement: SEO changes become difficult to evaluate when queries, pages, dates, or measurements shift. This skill maintains one controlled experiment with comparable observations and scheduled reviews.
actual_capabilities: Inspects the SEO ledger state and its three data files.
Records a fixed Search Console baseline for one query and target page.
Selects one eligible query while preventing concurrent monitored experiments.
Guides one focused page change based on a documented information gap.
Starts monitoring after verifying the public deployment date.
Reviews due experiments using comparable post-change observations.
limitations: Requires the geoptimize command-line tool and an existing SEO ledger.
Does not collect Google result pages or provide Search Console credentials.
Does not guarantee ranking, traffic, or conversion improvements.
Handles one monitored query at a time and depends on comparable observation windows.

use_cases.title: Measure a Content Update
use_cases.description: Track one page improvement against a fixed query and comparable Search Console observations.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Controlled Releases
use_cases.description: Separate page deployment from the monitoring start and preserve an auditable experiment history.

use_cases.title: Review Experiment Outcomes
use_cases.description: Compare due post-change observations without treating missing position data as proof of indexing status.

prompt_templates.title: Check Ledger Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the SEO ledger for [repository]. Summarize the current experiment, due reviews, and eligible queries without changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Record a baseline for query [query] and page [URL] using country [country], device [device], search type [type], and dates [window].

prompt_templates.title: Plan One Page Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Select the next eligible query in [repository]. Identify one visitor need and propose one focused page change for approval before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Due Experiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the due monitored query using observation [details]. Compare it with the baseline, preserve prior records, and recommend the next ledger state.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate a mature experiment with comparable data.

output_examples.input: Check the ledger status for the documentation repository.
output_examples.output: One query is monitoring and its review is due on 2026-09-18. No other query should be changed until that review is completed.

output_examples.input: Propose a focused change for the selected pricing query.
output_examples.output: The visitor needs a clear explanation of annual billing. Add one concise billing section and link to the cancellation policy.

output: Query and target page are fixed.
Country, device, and search type are preserved.
The complete baseline date window is recorded.
Monitoring has not started before deployment.

best_practices: Keep the exact query, page, country, device, search type, and date window consistent.
Make one focused page change so the experiment remains interpretable.
Verify the public page and publication date before starting monitoring.
anti_patterns: Do not run multiple monitored query experiments at the same time.
Do not overwrite earlier observations or commit credentials.
Do not present geoptimize scores or sparse position data as ranking proof.

faq.question: What does this skill track?
faq.answer: It tracks one exact query, one target page, fixed observation dimensions, a focused change, and a scheduled review.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. It organizes measurements and changes but makes no ranking promise.

faq.question: Can it monitor several queries together?
faq.answer: No. The workflow prevents another query from changing while one query is monitoring.

faq.question: Does it scrape Google search results?
faq.answer: No. The workflow explicitly prohibits custom Google result-page scraping.

faq.question: When should an experiment be reviewed?
faq.answer: Review it when its next review date is due and a comparable post-change observation is available.

faq.question: What access does the workflow require?
faq.answer: It needs the repository, geoptimize tooling, SEO ledger files, deployment access, and suitable Search Console observations.
